summary:
Signed/unsigned size mismatch when loading the vhost inflight region
buffer from an incoming migration stream. The vulnerable
vmstate_vhost_inflight_region_buffer (VMSTATE_VBUFFER_UINT64 on a
uint64_t size read back as int32_t) was added upstream in
3a80ff0721b6 ("vhost: add vmstate for inflight region with inner
buffer", January 2026, QEMU 11.x). The 1:10.0.13+ds-0+deb13u1 source
has neither that vmstate nor the VMSTATE_VBUFFER_UINT64 macro, so the
vulnerable code is not in this release. The upstream fix f9f70b50
reworks the vmstate size handling for that code. Re-evaluate if this
spec is ever rebased to a release containing 3a80ff0721b6.
https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-6426
